name: Samantha D.
text: We moved to Huntsville about a year ago and we worked with Aaron on our house addition and he did an incredible job. Aaron did all our framing for the addition, plus tying it in with the existing house. Aaron also hand framed the roof trusses and came up with a design that worked with the existing house. It was a tricky roof line to match.  His skills, knowledge, sense of design was very impressive. Not only is his work outstanding, he is a true, honest contractor. We loved working with Aaron so much that he helped my husband with some side projects around the house, removing large windows and installing the new ones, added in new basement beams, and my favourite, he built our owning over our side entry door, giving it that true Muskoka vibe. We discussed a view custom details for the awning frame and we loved collaborating with him. Aaron has become a close contact now with our family and we will be asking him to help with more projects on our property. I would highly recommended 'Spears Contracting' for your house project. You will be in good hands !
